Read AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and DOCUMENTATION_CONTRACT.md. These files
are the canonical instructions for all contributors and coding agents. Work
issue-first, leave needs-triage until both priority and size are verified, and
prefer the smallest supported change. Never invent Azure verification evidence.
AI review is advisory; final-head GitHub checks and maintainer authorization
govern squash merge. No Copilot-specific copy of repository policy.
